annotations.title: What is an old email list worth?

description: Estimates buyers and revenue from one offer to past customers in low / mid / high scenarios, with an optional partner revenue share.

buyRate.description: Expected percent of reached contacts who buy. Default 1.

orderValue.description: Average order value of the offer.

partnerShare.description: Optional partner revenue share percent. Default 0.

reachable.description: Percent of contacts still reachable. Default 70.
